title: Jessica Meir photography profile research
scope: Publicly documented connections and photography interests; editorial map recommendations, not a wishlist approved by Jessica.
coordinate_policy: Approximate city or landscape anchors. Nominatim results manually disambiguated; Scripps Pier result in La Playa rejected for the La Jolla result. No private locations.
iss_policy: 51.6degrees is the nadir latitude limit, not the total visibility limit. Sweden requires oblique viewing. McMurdo exceeds even ideal geometric horizon at typical400–430km ISS altitude.
